default.name: buitruonglinh
default.bio: buitruonglinh is a prominent Vietnamese singer-songwriter known for his emotional vocals and chart-topping hits. He has made a strong personal mark on the Vietnamese music market with his unique R&B and Pop ballads.

default.name: Dương Domic
default.bio:
Dương Domic is a standout face in Vietnam's music market, a true "from zero to hero" story. With well-rounded songwriting, production, and performance abilities, plus a bright vocal tone, Dương Domic carries youthful energy paired with depth and substance in his lyrics.

Dương Domic began his music career as a trainee under a Korean company with the MV "Candy." He then chose to join Sàn Đấu Vũ Đạo to learn and refine his abilities.

In 2024, Dương Domic returned to the music race...

default.name: Juky San
default.bio: Juky San is a popular female vocalist in Vietnam, famous for sweet, clear voice and youthful image. She rose to fame through successful covers and original music projects, establishing herself as a signature voice in V-Pop.
